title: Affair With Masala to Bring a New Indian Kitchen to Henderson
excerpt: A Clark County permit puts the planned Indian eatery at 2895 N Green Valley Parkway, Suite F, in Sunset Ridge Plaza — with no menu, website or opening date announced yet.
body:
• Affair With Masala Indian Cuisine is planned for 2895 N Green Valley Parkway, Suite F, Henderson, in the Sunset Ridge Plaza, according to a permit filed with Clark County and reported by WhatNow Las Vegas.
  • Raymond Herrera was listed on the permit for the opening.
  • The restaurant does not yet have a website or social media pages, and no menu or opening date has been announced; WhatNow described it as anticipated sometime next year.
  • For Henderson readers: this is a permit-stage opening, not a restaurant you can visit yet — the next useful news will be a menu and a date.

Henderson's Green Valley area is set to gain another Indian restaurant. Affair With Masala Indian Cuisine, a new concept for the Las Vegas Valley, is expected to open at 2895 N Green Valley Parkway, Suite F, according to a permit filed with Clark County. The address sits in the Green Valley North/Whitney Ranch area, inside the Sunset Ridge Plaza, also referred to as the Sunset Ridge Retail Center.

What is known so far

The permit names Raymond Herrera in connection with the opening. Beyond the permit, the public record is thin by design at this stage: Affair With Masala does not yet have a website or social media pages, and WhatNow reported that it did not hear back from the team by the time of publication. Hoodline's report likewise rests on the permit filing.

What is not announced yet

No menu, cuisine region, price range, hours or opening date has been published for the restaurant. WhatNow described the opening as anticipated sometime next year, which makes this a watch-this-space story rather than a plan-your-visit one. Reporting a dish list or a date now would be guessing, and the permit alone does not support either.

Why it matters locally

Green Valley and Whitney Ranch are established residential parts of Henderson where a neighbourhood Indian restaurant is a routine family decision — weeknight takeout, a first Diwali dinner out, a place to take visiting parents. A permit filing is the earliest reliable signal that such an option is coming. When the restaurant publishes a menu, hours and an opening date, those are the details that will turn this filing into a listing worth saving.
